name: @pryzm/geometry-wall
description: PRYZM — wall geometry subsystem. Types, store, fragment builder, instanced bridge, alignment guides, opening builders.
x-pryzm-exports-note: §WPE-CHROME-LAYER (L-10200) — './profile' and './profile-editor' are PURE subpaths so an app-layer panel can reach the wall-profile MODEL without pulling the barrel. WallProfile.ts imports only WallArcParam.ts, which imports nothing; WallProfileEditor.ts imports only a type from WallProfile.ts. No THREE, no DOM, no @thatopen at module scope. The barrel drags SlabTool -> @thatopen/ui, which evaluates `class extends HTMLElement` at module scope — that is why this package's vitest.config.ts needs happy-dom. §OUTLINE80-CYCLE-FIX (L-11260-series) added './opening-profile' for the SAME reason on a DIFFERENT edge: geometry-door's DoorTypes.ts and geometry-window's WindowTypes.ts need OPENING_PROFILE_KINDS (a runtime value, for their own z.enum) from this package, and the bare barrel drags in WallTool.ts -> @pryzm/command-registry -> geometry-door/geometry-window -> this package's barrel AGAIN, mid-evaluation — the same class of module-load cycle './store' etc. were minted to dodge. OpeningProfile.ts's own transitive imports (CustomOutline.ts, WallProfile.ts, WallArcParam.ts, @pryzm/geometry-kernel, @pryzm/geometry-slab/boundary-arc) touch none of WallTool/command-registry/WallStore/WallDataSchema, so this subpath cannot re-enter the barrel. Adding exports entries changes no dependency, so pnpm-lock.yaml is untouched. ⛔ Every key inside `exports` must start with '.': a '//' comment key there is ERR_INVALID_PACKAGE_CONFIG, which is why this note lives at the top level.
